# `integrity`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.40.0, family [GNSS measurements, positioning and integrity](../gnss-measurements-positioning-and-integrity.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Snapshot / solution-separation / ARAIM RAIM with HPL/VPL and a Stanford diagram.

One run of `scenarios/integrity-raim.toml` summarises as: integrity | 24 satellites | 344/361 epochs available (95.3%) | HAL 40 m VAL 50 m | sigma 1.0 m | Stanford(V): 0 integrity events, 0 HMI
